review_candidates.title: AI Systems Developer
review_candidates.description: About the Digital Education Council: The Digital Education Council (DEC) is a global community of practice of institutions spanning six continents. The Council is committed to driving sustainable innovation and AI adoption in Education and Workforce Development. Member institutions of the Digital Education Council represent a globally diverse and strategically balanced mix of research universities, business schools, polytechnics, liberal arts colleges, and community colleges. Collectively, they serve over 3 million students and employ more than 350,000 faculty and staff from a wide range of disciplines, making DEC one of the most globally representative alliances in education. DEC now counts over 190 member institutions. The Job: AI-native technical role You'll be a force multiplier for the whole organisation, building the AI-powered systems DEC runs on and finding new places where AI can make the company better. You will develop with AI as your daily instrument. You will own and extend the internal platforms at the heart of how we operate and hunt for practical, creative uses of AI across everything DEC does. This is a rare shape of role for someone early in their career: one builder, the whole stack, direct access to leadership, and a front-row seat to how a global education organisation actually operates. What you will do: Own the development of DEC's internal systems end to end: features, fixes, data and integrations — using AI coding tools daily and critically reviewing everything before it ships Run the infrastructure and keep our platforms trustworthy: security, access, backups and the care that member data demands Prototype new AI applications across the organisation: spot the opportunity, build the proof, show the team, and turn what works into how we operate Work directly with leadership on the organisation's most important priorities, translating business problems into systems that solve them Document as you go, so we can rely on structured processes and documentation Who we are looking for: A recent or imminent graduate of a Singapore university or polytechnic in computer science, software engineering, information systems or similar Already building with AI tools: you can show us something real you have made, and talk honestly about where the AI was wrong and how you caught it Solid technical foundations, with the curiosity to learn whatever the problem requires Proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript and SQL; React and Docker experience an advantage Genuinely detail-oriented: you notice things that does not reconcile, and you cannot let it go High energy and a great attitude: you want responsibility early, you follow through, and you would rather build something unique than be a small cog somewhere large Clear written English: your work will be read by non-engineers Singapore based with the right to work in Singapore Why apply for this role? Own real production systems from day one, with direct access to leadership and visible impact across the organisation Work at the front edge of AI: not just studying it but building with it daily Join a fast-growing, mission-driven organisation as it scales its impact globally

review_candidates.title: Software Engineer: First Party Security Products
review_candidates.description: We tackle the most complex problems in quantitative finance, by bringing scientific clarity to financial complexity. From our London HQ, we unite world-class researchers and engineers in an environment that values deep exploration and methodical execution - because the best ideas take time to evolve. Together we’re building a world-class platform to amplify our teams’ most powerful ideas. Security is foundational to this mission and must be delivered in a way that supports how our engineering teams build and operate complex systems at scale. Take the next step in your career. The role We're looking for a Software Engineer to join our Security Automation Engineering Team. The team designs and implements automated detection and response capabilities that protect G-Research’s diverse and complex estate, spanning high-performance compute (HPC) environments, Azure and Windows corporate infrastructure, and public cloud platforms such as AWS. As part of SAE, you’ll play a hands-on role building secure, scalable, and reliable automation systems that enable Security to respond faster, reduce manual effort, and improve our overall cyber resilience. You’ll work alongside experienced engineers and security specialists to deliver production-quality systems, contributing to the design, development, and continuous improvement of SAE’s platform and tooling ecosystem. SAE is a high-performing team of security professionals turned engineers. As part of this team, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute directly to G-Research’s defensive capabilities — developing tools and automation that help detect, respond to, and contain cyber threats at scale. This is an opportunity to work at the intersection of software engineering and cyber security, helping to solve meaningful security challenges at scale in one of the world’s most advanced computing environments. Key responsibilities of the role include: Design, build and maintain automated detection and response systems across G-Research’s hybrid environments (HPC, Azure, AWS). Develop high-quality, well-tested code primarily in Python, following secure engineering best practices. Implement and maintain infrastructure-as-code and CI/CD pipelines (e.g. Jenkins, ArgoCD). Collaborate with CSIRT and other security teams to integrate data and automation from tools such as Azure Defender XDR, AWS Security Hub, and Elastic Security. Participate in code reviews, contributing to a culture of quality, maintainability and security. Contribute to architectural discussions and design reviews, providing feedback and practical input on implementation approaches. Monitor system performance and reliability, identifying opportunities for operational improvement. Work with stakeholders to understand automation requirements and deliver robust, scalable solutions. Continuously improve development processes, documentation and engineering standards within the team. Who are we looking for? We're looking for experience in the following areas: Strong Python development skills with an understanding of secure software engineering and automation in complex environments. Practical experience building and maintaining production systems in at least one major public cloud provider (AWS or Azure). Familiarity with DevOps and infrastructure automation tooling (e.g. Jenkins, ArgoCD, Terraform, Ansible). Exposure to security operations tooling such as SIEM/XDR/SOAR platforms (e.g. Microsoft Sentinel, Elastic Security, AWS Security Hub). Experience working in agile delivery teams and collaborating with diverse technical stakeholders. Strong problem-solving skills and a passion for building clean, maintainable, and scalable systems. A growth mindset and desire to continuously improve systems, processes, and personal skills Why join us? Highly competitive compensation plus annual discretionary bonus Lunch provided via Just Eat for Business and dedicated barista bar 35 days’ annual leave 9% company pension contributions Informal dress code and excellent work-life balance Comprehensive healthcare and life assurance Cycle-to-work scheme Monthly company events
